note: Official registered cases and immutable instances. path is relative to cases/<case_id>; seed-1 uses the case root. candidate_cases/ are not auto-discovered.

terminology.case_family: One of the eight primary_event_theme categories defined in event_taxonomy.json.
terminology.case_id: One registered case unit within a case family.
terminology.instance_id: One immutable protocol instance of a registered case.
terminology.legacy_registry_field: case_families is retained as a schema-v2 compatibility field; its entries are registered cases, not the eight case families.
